description: Creates or updates time categories and stages, matched by ItemId then name, and adds time entries. A member left out of a category or stage keeps its stored value.

items.description: A time category: what time counts toward, such as paid or billable time.

ItemId.description: The category's id. When it matches a stored category, that category is updated; otherwise it is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

factor.description: How a minute counts toward the category. Defaults to 1.

enabled.description: Whether the category is in use.

Categories.description: The time categories to create or update.

items.description: A time stage: what a person is doing, such as working or on a break.

ItemId.description: The stage's id. When it matches a stored stage, that stage is updated; otherwise it is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id so activity codes that point at it still do.

selfService.description: Whether people can switch to it themselves.

enabled.description: Whether the stage is in use.

categories.description: The names of the categories its time counts toward. When present, they replace the stage's categories; a name that doesn't match a category is reported and skipped.

Stages.description: The time stages to create or update. Categories are imported first, so a stage can name a category of the same step.

items.description: A time entry. It is skipped when the person already has time in that range.

userName.description: The user name of the person; the user must exist.

stage.description: The name of the stage; it must exist or be listed in Stages.

startUtc.description: When the entry starts, in UTC.

endUtc.description: When the entry ends, in UTC.

source.description: Where the entry came from. Defaults to Import.
